coordinate_rule: In integer tenths of map units: first component = 9812 - map_y; second = map_x - 333. Each uses sign, at least three integer digits, decimal point, one fractional digit. Components separated by comma.
subtitle_behavior: NPCNumberPhrase formats numeric subtitle separately and selects original numeric voice clips by string IDs. Korean ENUMERATE text is not concatenated into the coordinate subtitle.
preservation: Do not normalize the transformed coordinates to map coordinates; retain signs, zero padding, suffix punctuation, voice filenames, and original digit PNG bytes.
limitations: Examples are arithmetic derived from pinned public source, not captures from the installed executable.
English audio remains English; this is not a Korean voice pack.
Actual subtitle splicing, timing and encounter state need runtime verification.
